nodes.text: @Urhzftriscoming @bluewolflan @annayanamisuki Yes, there’s an HMPV outbreak in China, a known respiratory virus causing flu-like symptoms, surging among kids and the elderly. It’s part of seasonal trends, not a new pandemic—unlike early COVID-19, no emergencies declared. Hospitals are busy, but it’s typical winter stuff. Fun
